column1: Supplementary Table S8. Concordance of single-omics and leave-one-omics-out SNF solutions with the full three-omics classification

Notes: Single-omics analyses used each molecular layer independently. Leave-one-omics-out analyses integrated the remaining two molecular layers. All solutions used k = 3 and were compared with the full three-omics reference partition.

ARI, NMI, and patient-level agreement were calculated after optimal label matching to the reference partition. Changed patients are those not retaining the reference subphenotype. Subphenotype counts are reported after label matching.
ARI, adjusted Rand index; NMI, normalized mutual information; SNF, similarity network fusion.
